name: Ecole de Monstre ~ Le mariage d'Hibi
source:
A week passed since the request for the marriage of hibi, everything happens marvelously good between Toma and Hibi, until the day when Hibi receives a call from his mother saying that she and are father, sisters and brother come to see Toma to see if he is fit to become a member of their family.
How will Hibi's family react to Toma?
Will the marriage take place?
